approval.basis: User continued the female day product breakdown and GitHub handoff workflow with the street editorials.

copy.captionKo: 퀼팅, 니트, 코듀로이. 부드러운 표면을 겹쳐요.
copy.captionEn: Quilting, knit and corduroy. Softness in layers.
copy.captionDe: Steppung, Strick und Cord. Weiche Texturen in Schichten.
copy.introKo: 샌드 퀼팅 재킷 안에 차콜 니트를 넣고, 밝은 그레이 머플러를 목에서 길게 이어줘요. 브라운 코듀로이의 굵은 골과 내추럴 캔버스 백으로 소재의 차이를 살리고, 작은 골드 톤 액세서리로 정리해요.
copy.introEn: Wear charcoal knit beneath a sand quilted jacket and let a light grey scarf fall long from the neck. Wide-wale brown corduroy and a natural canvas bag add texture, with small gold-tone accessories to finish.
copy.introDe: Trage anthrazitfarbenen Strick unter einer sandfarbenen Steppjacke und lasse einen hellgrauen Schal lang fallen. Grober brauner Cord und eine naturfarbene Canvas-Tasche ergänzen Textur; kleine goldfarbene Accessoires runden den Look ab.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 샌드 퀼팅 재킷 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: sand beige quilted short jacket with curved onion/wavy stitching, collarless bound neckline, rounded bound front hem, plain tonal snap/button front, loose rounded sleeves

products.descriptionKo: 아우터 안에서 니트의 표면을 보여줘요. 밑단을 정돈해 와이드 하의의 여유를 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Show the knit texture beneath the jacket and keep the hem neat above the wide trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige die Strickstruktur unter der Jacke und ordne den Saum über der weiten Hose.
products.altKo: 차콜 헤더 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: charcoal grey heather crewneck knit sweater with dark ribbed cuffs, soft slightly fuzzy knit, full long sleeves and concealed neckline conservative reconstruction

products.descriptionKo: 굵은 코듀로이 골을 눌러 펴지 않고 자연스러운 주름으로 남겨요. 퀼팅과 니트의 다른 표면을 함께 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Leave the wide cord ribs and soft folds natural, contrasting them with quilting and knit.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die breiten Cordrippen und weichen Falten natürlich und kontrastiere sie mit Steppung und Strick.
products.altKo: 브라운 코듀로이 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: brown wide-wale corduroy relaxed wide-leg trousers, rich visible vertical ribs and soft folds, elastic/gathered waist as visible, lower legs cropped out in reference and conservatively continued

products.descriptionKo: 목에 한 번 두르고 양 끝을 길게 늘어뜨려요. 프린지가 하의 위로 자연스럽게 이어지게 해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wrap once around the neck and let the ends fall long, with the fringe resting over the trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Lege den Schal einmal um den Hals und lasse die Enden lang über die Hose fallen.
products.altKo: 라이트 그레이 프린지 머플러 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE light grey softly fuzzy wool-look long scarf with short twisted fringes, plain heather grey, neatly laid full length

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 허기 후프 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair small gold-tone rounded huggie hoop earrings, match visible gold curved ear detail, no extra jewelry

products.descriptionKo: 소매 끝에서 가는 뱅글이 조금 보이게 해요. 과한 장식 없이 손목에 작은 포인트를 남겨요.
products.descriptionEn: Reveal a little of the slim bangle at the cuff for a small wrist accent.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse am Ärmel etwas vom schmalen Armreif sichtbar, als kleinen Akzent am Handgelenk.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 슬림 뱅글 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE thin plain gold-tone round bangle bracelet as visible at wrist near sandwich; no hands, conservative hidden side

products.descriptionKo: 내추럴 캔버스의 부드러운 형태를 그대로 살려요. 브라운 팬츠 옆에 밝은 면을 더하는 소품이에요.
products.descriptionEn: Keep the natural canvas soft, adding a pale panel beside the brown trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse das naturfarbene Canvas weich fallen; es setzt eine helle Fläche neben der braunen Hose.
products.altKo: 내추럴 캔버스 토트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE natural offwhite canvas tote bag based on partly visible cream fabric bag beside hip, soft plain rectangular fabric body, simple two canvas straps inferred; no printing or extra objects

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, linings, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite shoes are conservatively reconstructed.
Small jewelry forms and hidden clasps/posts are interpreted from visible details; actual metal is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition. Exact temperature and feels-like values are unknown.
Lower trouser legs are outside the frame and are reconstructed. Canvas tote body is partly visible; full bag shape and handles are inferred.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, shopping paper bags and keys are scene props, not outfit products.
Footwear and socks are outside the frame; not generated.
